issues.problem: The guide invents an unverified font family name and fabricates type tokens even though the packet provides no font family, font size, or attribution values.
issues.requiredChange: Remove the unsupported family claims and either omit typography token values that are not present in the manifest or restrict the section to what the packet actually supports.

issues.problem: The YAML defines exact UI colors and component tokens for gray, green, and red accents even though the authoritative exact-values manifest contains only black and white for interface colors and no exact spacing, radius, or font values.
issues.requiredChange: Limit exact UI tokens to values supported by the manifest; do not promote image-palette colors to interface tokens, and do not invent spacing or radius tokens when those exact values are absent.

issues.problem: The shape system invents rounded panels, tiles, and pills instead of using the required square-corner sentinel when no radii are supplied.
issues.requiredChange: Use `rounded.none: 0rem` as the only supported radius sentinel and avoid inventing additional radius values.
